name: Monitor Manager Pro
release_gate: Windows helper compile and scan smoke: REQUIRED
unit and capability parser fixtures: REQUIRED
four deterministic V2 bundled profiles with MONITORS / PROFILES / DISPLAY MODES / BRIGHTNESS surfaces: REQUIRED
official Stream Deck CLI validation and packaging: REQUIRED
deterministic Rat Art dimension gate: REQUIRED
60 / 120 / 144 / 165 / 240 Hz real-host matrix where hardware supports each mode: REQUIRED
one / two / three / four-monitor physical topology matrix: REQUIRED
external DDC/CI supported and unsupported monitor matrix: REQUIRED
monitor input supported and unsupported matrix: REQUIRED
sleep / wake, unplug / replug, restart, scaling and primary-display physical QA: REQUIRED
Monitor Profile COMPLETE / PARTIAL / FAILED and rollback physical QA: REQUIRED
Windows 11 24H2 HDR supported / unsupported physical QA: REQUIRED
notes: Price target $9.99. Commercial differentiation is the unified Windows + DDC/CI layer and saved whole-setup Monitor Profiles, not isolated brightness or projection-mode buttons. Exact HDR uses the dedicated Windows 11 24H2+ DisplayConfig HDR packets and fails closed on older ambiguous Advanced Color APIs. Night Light is excluded from v1 rather than using undocumented toggles.
blocker: Required Monitor Manager Pro release QA is incomplete: the hosted Windows build/Elgato package gate has not produced a successful current-head run, and the required physical multi-monitor/DDC/HDR/profile rollback matrix is not yet complete.
final_boundary: Pass build, tests, official Elgato validation/package, and the documented physical Windows QA matrix; then move this product to READY_TO_SHIP and publish Pro before enabling the Lite upsell.
